g.title: GAD_QSP
g.text: Generalized Anxiety Disorder · Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
One corticolimbic gain Phi = (E_amy × S_glu) / (C_pfc × I_gaba): four factors, four drug classes, four clocks — read out through an instrument that carries a fifth.
49-ODE mrgsolve model · 206 nodes · 19 mechanistic clusters · PK/PD for 7 anxiolytics coupled to circuit, HPA, plasticity, autonomic and trial-machinery layers

g.title: cluster_vuln
g.text: 1. Trait vulnerability · what sets DIS, the one severity knob

g.title: cluster_circ
g.text: 2. The threat circuit · numerator factor E_amy and denominator factor C_pfc

g.title: cluster_5ht
g.text: 3. Serotonin · the SLOW arm, slow twice over

g.title: cluster_gaba
g.text: 5. GABA-A · denominator factor I_gaba, and the subunit that decides tolerance

g.title: cluster_glu
g.text: 6. Glutamate and alpha2delta-1 · numerator factor S_glu

g.title: cluster_hpa
g.text: 7. HPA axis · the loop that had to be bounded

g.title: cluster_plast
g.text: 8. Neuroplasticity · how a transporter block becomes a slow clinical effect

g.title: cluster_auto
g.text: 9. Autonomic and somatic layer · the HAM-A somatic cluster

g.title: cluster_sleep
g.text: 10. Sleep · a symptom that is also a cause

g.title: cluster_pk1
g.text: 11. Serotonergic and noradrenergic drug PK/PD (measured occupancy anchors)

g.title: cluster_pk2
g.text: 12. GABAergic, alpha2delta and multireceptor drug PK/PD

g.title: cluster_ae
g.text: 14. Adverse effects · each with its own tolerance clock

g.title: cluster_trial
g.text: 15. Trial machinery · the fifth clock, and why it is not a nuisance term

g.title: cluster_eq
g.text: 16. The equation the whole map exists to state

g.title: cluster_comorb
g.text: 18. Comorbidity · where GAD stops being one disease

g.title: cluster_clock
g.text: The four clocks, side by side — and the fifth

g.text: the input that keeps the loop lit

g.text: Falls and fracture in older adults

g.text: SSRI in older adults; not dose-related

g.title: c_bnst
g.text: This, not CeA, is the GAD node

g.title: a_startle
g.text: BNST-dependent; the laboratory analogue of GAD

g.text: contextual safety; also the site of

g.text: reads the WORRY state most directly

g.text: moderate NE helps C_pfc; high NE hurts it

g.text: the SNRI dose-limiting effect at 225-375 mg

g.text: NE IS TWO EFFECTS AT ONCE

g.title: e_burden
g.text: feeds the dropout hazard, which is how

g.title: a_sns
g.text: driven by bounded excess z and by NE

g.title: g_gad67
g.text: reduced cortical GABA on MRS in GAD

g.title: g_kcc2
g.text: sets the SIGN of GABA-A currents;

g.title: g_dep
g.text: ONE state, TWO signs: subtracts 20% of the
effect on drug, and ALL of it after stopping

g.title: g_reb
g.text: => I_gaba falls BELOW the patient's own baseline

g.title: q_traf
g.text: WHY pregabalin needs a week, not a day

g.text: AMPA / NMDA on BLA principal cells

g.text: the clearance arm of glutamate tone

g.text: the HAM-A somatic item that tracks S_glu

g.text: driven by a SATURATING function of Phi

g.title: h_crhr1
g.text: the route by which the axis feeds

g.title: h_dst
g.text: the clinical read-out of GR function

g.title: h_run
g.text: CRH -> cortisol -> GR down -> weaker feedback
-> more CRH has gain > 1 if excess cortisol
enters linearly. It enters as x/(1+0.5x).

g.title: p_spine
g.text: PFC spines regrow; amygdala spines retract

g.text: the substrate CBT trains and the reason

g.title: p_neurog
g.text: permissive for behavioural effect in rodents

g.title: a_hrv
g.text: the most objective GAD biomarker available

g.text: -> a closed loop inside the disease

g.title: d_escocc
g.text: IS THIS HYPERBOLA, not a fitted curve

g.title: d_2d6
g.text: changes the parent:metabolite split, and so

g.title: d_venocc
g.text: SERT EC50 22.5 ng/mL, NET EC50 260 ng/mL
=> NET occupancy 26% at 75 mg, 51% at 225 mg

g.title: d_dlx
g.text: Css 31 ng/mL at 60 mg; SERT 0.80, NET 0.40

g.title: d_2c19
g.text: PM raises Css ~2x; the model treats this
as a CL/F covariate, and the flat occupancy
hyperbola is why it barely matters

g.title: d_bushead
g.text: Buspirone acts on BOTH sides of the same receptor
Net effect is small and slow, and the model shows why

g.title: d_pgb
g.text: F 0.90, t1/2 6.3 h, CLEARED BY THE KIDNEY

g.title: d_pgbocc
g.text: 0.71 at 600 -- a 29% gain for a 2x dose

g.title: d_lzp
g.text: V 90 L, t1/2 14 h, Css 22.5 ng/mL

g.title: d_alp
g.text: V 65 L, t1/2 12 h; converted to

g.title: d_hydrox
g.text: pure H1 antagonist; the mechanistic control
for 'is sedation the same thing as anxiolysis?'

g.title: d_taper
g.text: the rate at which Occ_bz falls
relative to DEPEND's tau of 20 d

g.title: x_cbt
g.text: enters at THREE places at once:

g.title: x_persist
g.text: WHY CBT'S GAIN OUTLASTS THE DRUG'S
It lowers E_amy, the factor a drug
does not reach and that does not

g.title: x_exer
g.text: (Bartley 2013 found no effect vs active controls)

g.title: x_icbt
g.text: same mechanism, lower dose of contact

g.title: x_comb
g.text: CBT moves E_amy, the drug moves C_pfc:
DIFFERENT factors of the same ratio

g.title: t_enrol
g.text: entry criteria select the top of a fluctuation

g.title: t_fluct
g.text: regression to the mean; ADDITIVE on the score,
because it is a selection artefact, not biology

g.title: k_hama
g.text: primary endpoint of every trial cited here

g.title: t_visit
g.text: each visit is an expectancy impulse

g.title: t_expect
g.text: Modelled as REAL top-down control, not as bias

g.title: t_assay
g.text: HAM-A saturates in Phi. A high-expectancy site
already sits on the flat part, so the SAME
pharmacology yields a smaller measured delta

g.title: t_multi
g.text: sites differ in e_ex, not in pharmacology

g.title: t_nma
g.text: differ mostly in their placebo clocks

g.title: t_sever
g.text: because Phi is a ratio, the SAME drug effect
is a LARGER HAM-A change at higher baseline

g.title: m_z
g.text: EVERY downstream consequence reads z, not Phi_n.
This is what makes the disease loop convergent

g.title: m_mult
g.text: Two denominator drugs divide Phi twice.
On HAM-A the same pair is SUB-additive,

g.title: m_sat
g.text: THE SATURATION IS THE POINT: it is why

g.title: y_pan
g.text: phasic CeA rather than sustained BNST

g.title: y_pain
g.text: shares the alpha2delta and SNRI arms
